{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "Textured tweed blazer, single-breasted, slightly cropped at the hip, in emerald green (#0F6B4F), wool bouclé

Silk-satin blouse, relaxed fit with a soft tie neck and long sleeves, in ivory (#F4EBDD), silk

High-waisted wide-leg trousers, full ankle length, in chocolate brown (#4A2F25), wool crepe

Pointed-toe ankle boots, block heel of moderate height, in cognac (#9C5A32), smooth leather

Structured top-handle bag, medium size, in deep burgundy (#6B1E2E), grained leather

Sculptural oversized drop earrings in warm gold (#C9A24B), polished metal

Why this outfit works: The emerald bouclé blazer is the standout piece, and it brings out the green-grey of your eyes while looking rich against your golden hair and warm skin. The ivory blouse and chocolate trousers keep the look polished and appropriate for an office, so the boldness comes from color and texture rather than from breaking the dress code. The wide-leg trousers lengthen the line, and the cognac boots and burgundy bag add warm, deliberate contrast that makes the outfit memorable. Gold earrings finish it with one confident detail near your face."}
